full_name: Paula T. Hammond | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: In her research group, Paula T. Hammond examines the behavior of polymers (large, long-chain molecules) that are designed to arrange themselves into larger structures which offer promising applications.
